Title: Azure Local Endpoints Codified
Summary: This Jumpstart Drop for Azure Local includes a PowerShell script, GitHub workflow and frontend to interact with all URL endpoints required for each Azure region and vendor. The output is codified in JSON format to aid in automation purposes.
